text.content:
• Fixed: duplicate-detection now parses German-formatted odometer values ('85.000 km') from pre-format-change saved listings — one shared mileage parser (src/lib/mileage.ts) between the results list and the same-car check, was two copies with one still doing a bare Number(). Zero API cost.
• 💡 Built: 'Recent searches' — the app now remembers the last 5 distinct search queries and shows them as one-tap chips under the search bar (fills the box, never auto-searches). Previously only the single latest search was kept, so comparing several cars meant retyping.
• Both verified live on the deployed site; no console errors.
